notes: Access: direct fetch worked (HTTP 200, no WAF). Shopify store (pure-home-living-gh.myshopify.com), theme 'Gecko' (t4s/Woodmart-family). Site has 283 collections in /collections.json spanning ~7363 SKUs, heavily polluted with sale/price-tier/occasion/gift-guide/SEO-duplicate collections (e.g. 'Products under 3000', 'Diwali Gift Ideas', 'Mother's Day Gifts', 'Employee-Sale', 'Meta Export', 'MRP'), all excluded per NEVER-EXTRACT rule. Hierarchy was built from the site's own in-page 'shop by category' tile widgets (found on each collection page, e.g. Home Decor page links to Decoratives/Candle Stands/Vases/Home Fragrances/Scented Candles tiles; Decoratives links to Photo Frames/Urns/Sculptures & Figurines/Decorative Platters/Decorative Bowls/Decorative Jars/Canisters/Decor Objects/Ashtray; Candle Stands links to Candle Stem Holders/Hurricanes/Lanterns/Tealight Holders; Vases links to Glass/Ceramic Vases; Kitchen & Dining links to Cutlery/Dinnerware/Table Accessories/Tea & Coffee; Dinnerware links to Dinner/Dessert/Charger Plates, Cookie Stand, Side/Salad Bowls, Serving Bowls-Platters/Tray; Table Accessories links to Table Napkin/Napkin Rings/Placemats; Tea & Coffee links to Coffee Mugs/Tea Cups & Saucer; Bar & Drinkware links to Bar Accessories/Bar Glasses; Bath & More links to Bath Accessories/Bath Towel/Bath Mats/Wicker Accessories; Faux Leather links to Leather Accessories/Storage & Organisers/Office Collection). The mega-menu itself is AJAX-lazy-loaded (empty t4s-loading--bg placeholders in static HTML) so it was NOT usable; the in-page tile widgets were the reliable static source. ALL qty verified by RULE 1 enumeration (probe.py shopify_count: paged /collections/<handle>/products.json?limit=250, distinct product IDs counted) -- NOT the /collections.json products_count field, which was measurably inflated vs enumeration on this store (e.g. decorative-platters: products_count=149 vs enumerated=136; hurricanes: products_count=321 vs enumerated=302; tea-light-holders: products_count=282 vs enumerated=265; photoframes: products_count=236 vs enumerated=229). EXCLUSIONS (checked by sampling actual product titles via products.json): Home Fragrances, Scented Candles, Wax Filled Jars, Votive Candles, Pillar & Taper Candles (all titles confirm scented, e.g. 'Neroli Scented Bell Jar Glass Candle', 'Mustard Oud Pillar Candle') -- Home Fragrance exclusion. Flowers & Greens (all faux/artificial per titles) and 'Potted Plants/Trees' -- faux-plant exclusion; kept 'Pots' (planters, titles show empty aluminium/ceramic planters, not artificial-plant-in-pot combos) as in-scope Planters. Home Textile, Bath Towels, Bath Mats, Table Napkin, Placemats, Wicker Placemats -- textile exclusion. Cutlery, Bar Tools & Equipments, Cocktail Shaker, Stirrers, Chiller, Ice Bucket -- bar-tool/cookware exclusion. Dustbins, Laundry Baskets, Storage Boxes -- excluded from 'Bath Accessories' (mixed rollup: titles showed waste bins + genuinely decorative soap dish/dispenser/toothbrush holder) by using the narrower standalone soap-dish/soap-dispenser/tooth-brush-holder/bathroom-tray collections instead of the polluted 77-item 'Bath Accessories' rollup. 'Bar Accessories' (mixed rollup of glass jugs + faux-leather coasters, overlapping items already counted under Faux Leather Coasters) was dropped in favour of the clean 'Bar Glasses & Tumblers' collection only. Faux Leather sub-collections for organisers/storage-box/paper-bin/paper-tray/pen-stand/notepad-holder/envelope-holder/pouffe/magazine-basket/watch-organizer/tissue-holder/laundry-basket/office-collection excluded as functional storage/office items, not decorative accessories; kept only Faux Leather Trays, Photo Frames, Coasters (explicit decorative-accessory types). 'Faux Leather Bathroom Tray' (7) dropped as a subset already inside 'Faux Leather Trays' (avoid double-count). Duplicate/overlapping SEO landing collections not part of site navigation, all subsets of already-counted core collections verified by title overlap, were dropped to avoid double-counting: Animal/Bird Statue and Buddha Statue for Home (both subsets of Sculptures & Figurines -- shared SKUs confirmed by title match), Lord Ganesha Statue and Wildlife Inspired and Animal & Bird Inspired Decor (overlap with Sculptures & Figurines / Vases / Candle Stem Holders), Baskets (overlap with excluded faux-leather magazine baskets), Jewellery Organisers / Jewellery Boxes with Initials (functional storage, faux-leather jewellery boxes), Wine Glasses (subset/duplicate of Bar Glasses & Tumblers, titles overlap e.g. 'Sitta Red Wine Glass' appears in both), 'Decorative Boxes' (only 2 SKUs, both mistagged wine glasses -- not real boxes, dropped as junk). Lighting/Lamps/Lamp Shades collections exist but are confirmed genuinely EMPTY (0 products in both /collections.json and live products.json) -- no lighting category currently sold on this site. LED Candles (34, flameless decorative candles, unscented) included as a candle-holder-adjacent decor item per RULE 0. Mirrors: found via /collections.json only (not linked in any current on-page tile nav), 7 SKUs, all genuine vanity mirrors -- included per mandatory Mirrors-in-scope rule. Company legitimacy: purehomeandliving.com is Pure Home + Living, an established Delhi-NCR-headquartered Indian home decor/lifestyle retailer with 10 physical stores listed (Delhi NCR, Bangalore, Mumbai, Pune, Punjab, Ahmedabad, Chennai, Jaipur, Kolkata, Lucknow, Indore, Hyderabad) -- genuine retailer, no duplicate-company concern found in this batch.
